facts_from_source: Applicable to the services branded as (a) Slack, including Slack AI and (b) GovSlack.

Slack services, including Slack AI (excluding GovSlack): Hosting provider for all functionality. Customers may select a data region, but as described in this help article, certain Customer Data may be stored outside this data region.
The hosting provider named for that function is Amazon Web Services, Inc. The listed locations include Singapore.

Slack services including Slack AI (excluding GovSlack): Hosting provider for Availability zones/Edge servers for all functionality. Customer Data may be transmitted through any Edge region. Singapore is one of the listed Edge locations.
do_not_use: 同一份 PDF 里 Automotive Cloud 的 AWS 句子只适用于那个附加功能，不能写成 Slack 的一般事实。
